_doc: Per-step bounds for tools/gor_step.py. 'limit' is a POLICY hard upper bound in seconds (the wrapper stops the step after it and says so); it is not a measurement. 'measured' lists durations measured on the owner's Mac (capture files on gor-capture-mac); steps with no entry have nothing measured yet and use 'limit' only until the Mac's own history (step-history.jsonl) has runs. 'rate_bps_assumed' is only used with GOR_STEP_BYTES and is replaced by the measured rate after the first successful run.
